videos.title: Breaking Down the Markets Massive Post-Midterm Moves with Andy Constan
videos.description: The Democrats decisive victories in this years midterm elections are already rocking markets and will surely have continued ripple effects for stocks, bonds, and macro universe. Andy Constan  of Damped Spring Advisors joins Monetary Matters Live to breakdown the early reaction from the market and the biggest macro knock on effects.
